WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(sp.memusagegb) as col3,
    AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(sp.proccpu, 0)) as col4
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat
)
SELECT 
  entrystat,
  AVG(col3) as avg_memusagegb,
  AVG(col4) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM step1
GROUP BY entrystat
